narrative: Added environment loading and fallback pattern handling to ensure discovery generation script can attempt dataset creation even when pattern config is missing. TTF and MLF helpers now retry with default columns for the 'mz' pattern and auto-create TTF if MLF generation fails. Script also checks user config files.
purpose: Provide smoother dataset generation flow without manual config tweaks, enabling diagnostics when ForexConnect login fails.
future_scene: Before: missing pattern 'mz' triggered FileNotFoundError. Now: code falls back to default columns and proceeds until ForexConnect login failure.
